You are taking part in a research experiment on programming neural-network weights by hand.

Your task pack is the folder /home/traffic-ntua/wsp_v3_agent_runs/patch_fault/net0_b0_r3

Start by reading TASK.md in that folder, then follow it exactly. In particular:
- Read only files inside the pack.
- Write only to its work/ subfolder.
- Do not run any simulator. You get one shot.
- Do not fit weights to data with any optimiser.
- Change at most 371 parameters.

When you finish, make sure work/weights.npz, work/NOTES.md and work/predictions.json exist. Then reply with a short summary (under 200 words) covering:

result.result:
I repaired the network so it estimates the missing W2 readings from detectors that still work, changing 301 of the 371 allowed parameters. `work/weights.npz`, `work/NOTES.md` and `work/predictions.json` are in place, plus the scripts.

**What I changed and why:** the network relies heavily on the W2 left-turn pocket. With W2 stuck at 0, it rarely gives the west left-turners the EW_left (phase 3) green. Their pocket then backs up into the upstream lane and blocks straight traffic too. I gave the network a substitute for W2:
1. **Copy:** W2 now reads the same as E2, the east pocket, which has the same demand and gets green in the same phase. This is done exactly in layer 1 (128 parameters).
2. **"Pocket full" signal:** I turned the least important hidden unit (unit 57) into a switch. It turns on when at least one car is halted on upstream lane W1u while phase 3 is not green. On the lanes that work, that pattern means a full pocket 85–99% of the time. When it's on, the next layer receives the average effect of a full W2, measured with forward passes only.

**Checks:** agreement with the start network fed this substitute W2 is 98.6% (the broken network: 75.5%). In the "pocket full" states during the EW through green, it now picks the left phase 721/776 times, against 369 before. I also ran a synthetic stress sweep (outputs stay in a normal range and change in one direction) and tested on the north/south pockets.

**Test predictions (TTS, veh-h):** low 35.1, nominal 45.8, high 57.2.
